tools.name: searchForClasses
tools.description: Searches for classes by name matching the query substring (case-insensitive).Arguments:- query: stringReturn values:- foundClassNames: array of class names as strings- mayHaveMore: boolean indicating if there are more matches than returnedExample JSON arguments:{  "query": "Collection"}Example JSON response:{  "foundClassNames": ["Collection", "CollectionSequence"],  "mayHaveMore": false}

tools.name: classSubclasses
tools.description: Retrieve all subclasses of the given class.Arguments:- className: stringReturn values:- givenClassName: the input class name string- subclassNames: array of subclass names as stringsExample JSON arguments:{  "className": "Object"}Example JSON response:{  "givenClassName": "Object",  "subclassNames": ["Behavior", "UndefinedObject"]}

tools.name: lookupClass
tools.description: Get the details of a class as JSON.Arguments:- className: stringReturn values:- currentClassName: class name string- superclassName: superclass name string or nil- comment: class comment- packageName: package name- instanceSlotNames: array of instance slot names- classSlotNames: array of class slot names- allInstanceMethodNames: array of selectors- allClassMethodNames: array of selectorsExample JSON arguments:{  "className": "Collection"}Example JSON response:{  "currentClassName": "Collection",  "superclassName": "SequenceableCollection",  "comment": "...",  "packageName": "Collections-Sequenceable",  "instanceSlotNames": ["array"],  "classSlotNames": [],  "allInstanceMethodNames": ["at:", "size"],  "allClassMethodNames": ["withAll:"]}

tools.name: classReferences
tools.description: Search the image for the references to the given class.Arguments:- className: stringReturn values:- givenClassName: the input class name string- references: array of method references- mayHaveMore: boolean indicating if there are more matches than returnedExample JSON arguments:{  "className": "Collection"}Example JSON response:{  "givenClassName": "Collection",  "references": [    {      "methodClassName": "Collection",      "methodName": "withAll:",      "classSide": true    }  ],  "mayHaveMore": false}

tools.name: methodReferences
tools.description: Search the image for the senders of the given selector.Arguments:- methodName: stringReturn values:- foundMethods: array of method references- mayHaveMore: boolean indicating if there are more matches than returnedExample JSON arguments:{  "methodName": "value"}Example JSON response:{  "foundMethods": [    {      "methodClassName": "Object",      "methodName": "value",      "classSide": false    }  ],  "mayHaveMore": false}

tools.name: getImplementors
tools.description: Gets a method by name and returns a list of methods that implement it.Arguments:- methodName: stringReturn values:- foundMethods: array of method references- mayHaveMore: boolean indicating if there are more matches than returnedExample JSON arguments:{  "methodName": "performToolCall:"}Example JSON response:{  "foundMethods": [    {      "methodClassName": "GtLAbstractFunctionTool",      "methodName": "performToolCall:",      "classSide": false    }  ],  "mayHaveMore": false}

tools.name: getCodeOfMethods
tools.description: Gets source code for multiple methods. Arguments must provide a methodDescriptors array of method descriptors with methodClassName, methodName, and optional classSide values.Example JSON arguments:{  "methodDescriptors": [    {"methodClassName": "Collection", "methodName": "withAll:", "classSide": true},    {"methodClassName": "GtLToolForMethodImplementors", "methodName": "privatePerformToolCall:", "classSide": false}  ]}Example JSON response:{  "methods": [    {"methodReference": {"methodName": "withAll:", "methodClassName": "Collection", "classSide": true}, "sourceCode": "..."},    {"methodReference": {"methodName": "privatePerformToolCall:", "methodClassName": "GtLToolForMethodImplementors", "classSide": false}, "sourceCode": "..."}  ]}

tools.name: packageClasses
tools.description: Retrieve all classes defined or extended in the given package.Arguments:- packageName: stringReturn values:- foundClassNames: array of class names as strings- mayHaveMore: boolean indicating if there are more matches than returnedExample JSON arguments:{  "packageName": "Bloc"}Example JSON response:{  "foundClassNames": ["BlElement", "BlSpace"],  "mayHaveMore": true}

tools.name: substringLiteralSearch
tools.description: Searches for methods by substring literal match.Arguments:- query: stringReturn values:- foundMethods: array of method references- mayHaveMore: boolean indicating if there are more matches than returnedExample JSON arguments:{  "query": "substringLiteralSearch"}Example JSON response:{  "foundMethods": [    {      "methodClassName": "GtLToolForSubstringLiteralSearch",      "methodName": "privatePerformToolCall:inContext:",      "classSide": false    }  ],  "mayHaveMore": false}

tools.name: lepiterKnowledgeBases
tools.description: Retrieve the registered Lepiter knowledge bases.

tools.name: searchForLepiterPages
tools.description: Searches for Lepiter pages by name matching the query substring (case-insensitive).

tools.name: getLepiterPageContents
tools.description: Gets the serialized contents of a Lepiter page identified by UID.

tools.name: createClassesAndTraits
tools.description: Creates multiple classes and traits in a single request and reports each result. Trait names usually starts with "T".Example JSON arguments:{  "classes": [    {"targetClassName": "MyClass", "superclassName": "Object", "package": "MyPackage", "packageTag": "MyTag", "traitComposition": "{TMyTrait}"},    {"targetClassName": "MySubclass", "superclassName": "MyClass", "package": "MyPackage", "instanceVariables": "value", "classInstanceVariables": "valueTwo"}  ],  "traits": [    {"targetTraitName": "TMyTrait", "package": "MyPackage", "packageTag": "MyTag", "traitComposition": "{}"},    {"targetTraitName": "TMyTraitTwo", "package": "MyPackage", "instanceVariables": "value", "classInstanceVariables": "valueTwo", "traitComposition": "{TMyTrait}"}  ]}Example JSON response:{  "classes": [    {"currentClassName": "MyClass", "superclassName": "Object", "packageName": "MyPackage", "packageTag": "MyTag", "instanceSlotNames": [], "classSlotNames": [], "classVariableNames": [], "traitCompositionString": "{TMyTrait}"},    {"currentClassName": "MySubclass", "superclassName": "MyClass", "packageName": "MyPackage", "instanceSlotNames": ["value"], "classSlotNames": [ "valueTwo" ], "traitCompositionString": "{}"}  ],  "traits": [    {"currentTraitName": "TMyTrait", "packageName": "MyPackage", "instanceSlotNames": [], "classSlotNames": [], "traitCompositionString": "{}"},    {"currentTraitName": "TMyTraitTwo", "packageName": "MyPackage", "instanceSlotNames": ["value"], "classSlotNames": ["valueTwo"], "traitCompositionString": "{TMyTrait}"}  ]}

tools.name: changeClassOrTraitSignature
tools.description: Changes a class signature by updating superclass, instance variables, class variables, package, package tag. 		It also changes a Trait signature by updating instance variables, class instance variables, package, and package tag. In terms of definition, trait is a specialized class, so it have same arguments. It therefore defines trait name using `targetClassName` argument. Trait does not define superclassName, neither `classVariables`.Example JSON arguments:{  "classChangeRequest": {    "targetClassName": "MyClass",    "superclassName": "NewSuperclass",    "traitComposition": "{TMyTrait}",    "instanceVariables": ["slot1", "slot2"],    "classInstanceVariables": ["slot3", "slot4"],    "classVariables": ["SharedValue"],    "package": "MyPackage",    "packageTag": "MyTag"  }}Example JSON response:{  "currentClassName": "MyClass",  "superclassName": "NewSuperclass",  "packageName": "MyPackage",  "instanceSlotNames": ["slot1", "slot2"],  "classSlotNames": ["slot3", "slot4"],  "classVariableNames": ["SharedValue"],  "traitCompositionString": "{}"}

tools.name: changeClassOrTraitComment
tools.description: Change the class or trait comment. Both, class and trait use the same argument names and response structure.Example JSON arguments:{  "className": "MyClass",  "classComment": "description of the class"}Example JSON response:{  "className": "MyClass",  "status": "changed"}

tools.name: compileMethods
tools.description: Compiles multiple method sources across classes and reports each result.Arguments:- methods: array of method compilation requestsExample JSON arguments:{  "methods": [    {"methodClassName": "MyClass", "sourceCode": "myMethod ^ 42", "protocol": "accessing", "classSide": false},    {"methodClassName": "MyClass", "sourceCode": "anotherMethod ^ 1", "protocol": "accessing", "classSide": false}  ]}Example JSON response:{  "methods": [    {"status": "compiled"},    {"status": "compiled"}  ]}

tools.name: removeMethods
tools.description: Removes multiple methods across classes and reports each result.Arguments:- methods: array of method descriptors with methodClassName, methodName, and classSideExample JSON arguments:{  "methods": [    {"methodClassName": "MyClass", "methodName": "method1", "classSide": false},    {"methodClassName": "MyClass", "methodName": "method2", "classSide": true}  ]}Example JSON response:{  "methods": [    {"status": "removed"},    {"status": "removed"}  ]}

tools.name: removeClass
tools.description: Removes the class with the provided name from the image.Example JSON arguments:{  "className": "MyClass"}Example JSON response:{  "removedClassName": "MyClass",  "status": "removed"}

tools.name: createLepiterPage
tools.description: Create a new Lepiter page in a database with the provided title and target database id.Example JSON arguments:{  "title": "New Page",  "databaseId": "UUID"}Example JSON response:{  "status": "created",  "pageUid": "UUID",  "title": "New Page"}

tools.name: removeLepiterPage
tools.description: Remove a Lepiter page using the database and page identifiers.Example JSON arguments:{  "databaseId": "UUID",  "pageUid": "UUID"}Example JSON response:{  "status": "removed",  "databaseId": "UUID",  "pageUid": "UUID",  "title": "Page Title"}

tools.name: editLepiterSnippet
tools.description: Edits a Lepiter snippet identified by page and snippet ids, updating the snippet text.

tools.name: createLepiterSnippets
tools.description: Creates new Lepiter snippets for pages identified by their page ids.Example JSON arguments:{  "snippets": [    {"TextSnippet": {"pageUid": "UUID", "snippetText": "Notes"}},    {"PharoSnippet": {"pageUid": "UUID", "pharoCode": "Transcript show: 1"}},    {"ExampleSnippet": {"pageUid": "UUID", "exampleClassName": "MyExamples", "exampleMethodName": "exampleMethod"}}  ]}Supported snippet types are: text, pharo, python, shell, example.Example JSON response:{  "snippets": [    {"status": "created", "pageUid": "UUID", "snippetUid": "UUID"},    {"status": "created", "pageUid": "UUID", "snippetUid": "UUID"}  ]}

tools.name: removeLepiterSnippets
tools.description: Remove one or more Lepiter snippets using the knowledge base, page, and snippet identifiers.Example JSON arguments:{  "snippets": [    {"knowledgeBaseUid": "UUID", "pageUid": "UUID", "snippetUid": "UUID"},    {"knowledgeBaseUid": "UUID", "pageUid": "UUID", "snippetUid": "UUID"}  ]}Example JSON response:{  "snippets": [    {"status": "removed", "pageUid": "UUID", "snippetUid": "UUID"},    {"status": "removed", "pageUid": "UUID", "snippetUid": "UUID"}  ]}

tools.name: exampleMethodRun
tools.description: Execute a gtExample method. It returns:- status: Succeess, Error, Failure, Skipped.- and the result:  1. if it succeeds:     - the resulting object as one or more JSON or image entries, each representing a view of the resulting object. Look at all of them to interpret the result.    - the object id that you can use as reference for other tool calls.    - the playgroundPageReference to the contextual playground page. Use that page to look for object specific snippets and explanations.  2. if there is an exception, it gets the errorDetails (errorMessage, stackTrace, errorClass). It can also get other JSON or image entries each representing a view of the exception. Look at all of them to interpret the result.

tools.name: examplesInClassesRun
tools.description: Execute multiple gtExample methods gathered from one or more classes and report the aggregated results. The argument `classNames` is mandatory and it must be a non empty array of space separated strings holding class names.Examples:- To run just one class, provide an array with one value as the `classNames` value:```"classNames": "SomeClassWithExamples"```- running multiple classes:```"classNames": "SomeClassWithExamples SomeOtherClassWithExamples"]```

tools.name: smalltalkCodeEvaluation
tools.description: Executes the provided Smalltalk code. It returns1. if it succeeds: - the resulting object as one or more JSON or image entries, each representing a view of the resulting object. Look at all of them to interpret the result.- the object id that you can use as reference for other tool calls.- the playgroundPageReference to the contextual playground page. Use that page to look for object specific snippets and explanations.2. if there is an exception, it gets the errorDetails (errorMessage, stackTrace, errorClass). It can also get other JSON or image entries each representing a view of the exception. Look at all of them to interpret the result.Do not compile code using this tool. Do not delete files using this tool. Use this tool only as a last resort to investigate objects.Arguments:- code: string- bindings: array of binding objects with name and objectId (pass empty array if not needed)Example JSON arguments:{  "code": "1 + 2",  "bindings": []}Example JSON arguments with bindings:{  "code": "value + 2",  "bindings": [{"name": "value", "objectId": "uuid-string"}]}Example JSON response:{  "code": "1 + 2",  "objectValue": {    "objectClassName": "SmallInteger",    "superclassName": "Integer",    "packageName": "Kernel",    "objectPrintString": "3",    "phlowViews": [{"methodName": "gtPrintFor:", "title": "Print"}],    "allInstanceSlots": []  },  "objectId": "uuid-or-empty",  "playgroundPageReference" : {		"databaseId" : "auhvwh3wo4eisu1kci9jdew92",		"pageId" : "9fxzw74ztlk895vquuwasakr"	}}Example JSON error response:{	"errorReason" : "Error while evaluating smalltalk code",	"errorDetails" : {		"stackTrace" : "...",		"errorClass" : "ZeroDivide",		"errorMessage" : "ZeroDivide"	},	"code" : "1 / 0"}

tools.name: getViewContent
tools.description: Returns a phlow view for an object given an object id and a method name

tools.name: listObjectStorage
tools.description: Lists the objects in the object storage of a chat.

tools.name: getObjectStorageValue
tools.description: Retrieves an object from the object storage and returns its serialized value, equivalent to inspecting it in the Smalltalk code evaluation tool.

tools.name: getObjectStorageSlotValue
tools.description: Retrieves the value of a named slot from an object in the object storage and returns a serialized object value result for that slot value.
